visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a top-down view of two large orange Hermès boxes sitting on a soft white bed. A woman's hands, adorned with rings and a gold bracelet, enter the frame and tap rhythmically on the lid of the smaller box. She then carefully unties the black logo-printed ribbon, pulling it away from the box. (2) The woman lifts the lid off the box to reveal crisp white tissue paper. She gently pulls back the paper layers, producing a tactile display of material handling. From within, she retrieves a cream-colored fabric dustbag featuring a dark circular logo. She begins to loosen the drawstring to access the contents. (3) A black fabric bag with leather trim and silver-toned hardware is extracted from the dustbag. The woman holds the bag, turning it slightly to showcase its structured shape and the contrasting textures of the canvas-like body and smooth leather flaps. The background remains a clean, minimalist bedroom setting with white pillows. (4) Shifting focus to the second, larger orange box, the woman repeats the process of untying the black decorative ribbon. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the vibrant orange of the luxury packaging against the neutral tones of the bedding and the woman's manicured nails. (5) After removing the lid and tissue paper from the second box, a larger dustbag is brought into view. She pulls out a beige and dark brown canvas tote bag, known as the Garden Party style. The contrast between the light canvas and the dark leather handles is clearly visible. (6) The woman presents a fluffy panda-shaped plush keychain to the camera. She then attaches it to the handle of the beige canvas tote. She rotates the bag to show the final look with the accessory attached, concluding the unboxing sequence in the same bright, indoor environment.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a series of sharp, percussive tapping sounds as fingertips strike a cardboard surface. This is followed by the soft, friction-based rustle of a ribbon being pulled and sliding across itself. An upbeat, acoustic guitar-driven background music begins, maintaining a steady, moderate tempo throughout the segment. (2) A distinct, high-frequency crinkling sound of tissue paper being manipulated dominates this phase. The paper noise is crisp and dense, indicating multiple layers being moved. Underneath, the BGM continues with a bright, melodic quality, featuring light percussion and string textures that create a cheerful atmosphere. (3) The sound of fabric-on-fabric friction occurs as a dustbag is handled. There is a low-frequency sliding noise as a solid object is pulled from the bag. The acoustic environment is very clean, resembling a studio or quiet indoor space, allowing these small foley-like sounds to be heard clearly alongside the music. (4) Repetitive sounds of ribbon rustling and cardboard lid movement are heard again. The BGM remains consistent in volume and energy, with no vocal interference. The transient sounds of the ribbon being untied are sharp and clear, followed by more paper crinkling as the second box is opened. (5) Heavier fabric rustling sounds are audible as a larger item is handled. The BGM reaches a bridge or chorus section, increasing slightly in harmonic complexity but maintaining its positive valence. The sound of the bag being set down on a soft surface produces a muffled, low-bandwidth thud. (6) A metallic clicking sound is heard, indicating a clasp or ring being opened and closed. This is followed by the soft sound of plush material being squeezed. The video ends with the BGM fading out, leaving a brief moment of room tone before the track cuts off completely.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase a high-end luxury unboxing experience for Hermès bags. It focuses on the tactile and visual appeal of the packaging, the anticipation of opening the boxes, and the final reveal of the products and an accompanying accessory.
